purpose: ICDE 2027 Industry and Application Track fit assessment; public paper copies for local reading

cfp.required_affiliation: At least one author must have a non-academic affiliation; this condition alone does not make a paper industrial.
cfp.short_paper_limit: 6 pages of main content plus unlimited reference pages
cfp.long_paper_limit: 12 pages of main content plus unlimited reference pages
cfp.scope: Innovative industrial-strength data management systems, solutions, and demanding application scenarios; system/project overviews without articulated innovation are discouraged.
cfp.deployment_note: The CFP does not specify a mandatory production deployment duration, user count, or data volume. Recommendations in the assessment are not official numeric acceptance thresholds.

papers.title: Deep Learning with Spatiotemporal Data: A Deep Dive into GeotorchAI
papers.copy_note: Public author-hosted copy; pagination is PDF pagination, not proceedings page numbering.

reading_evidence.contribution: Scalable spatial preprocessing using Apache Sedona, ready-to-use deep learning components, and DFtoTorch conversion from preprocessed DataFrames to training tensors.
reading_evidence.evaluation: PDF pages 9-12, Section V: four application categories; tensor preparation compared with GeoPandas at 1.4M, 14M, 100M, and 250M trip records. The comparison is explicitly single-machine for fairness, not a cluster scaling experiment.
reading_evidence.repeated_runs: Traffic and weather models evaluated over five runs with variation reported.
reading_evidence.end_to_end_example: PDF page 12, Table VIII, five transforms: on-the-fly training 32977 s versus preprocessing 1276 s plus pretransformed training 22429 s, totaling 23705 s.
reading_evidence.deployment_note: The sections inspected demonstrate a reusable library and benchmark experiments; they do not establish a mandatory production deployment requirement for the track.

papers.title: Xorbits: Automating Operator Tiling for Distributed Data Science
papers.copy_note: Version-pinned author preprint; may differ from the final proceedings version.

reading_evidence.contribution: Dynamic operator tiling from runtime metadata, multi-level computation graphs, graph fusion, and distributed dataframe/array processing.
reading_evidence.evaluation: PDF pages 10-12, Section VI: dataframe pipelines, TPC-H and array workloads; Table III includes 20-358 GB workloads, up to 16 worker instances; workload-specific IO timing boundaries are declared.
reading_evidence.baselines: pandas, pandas API on Spark, Dask, Modin on Ray; Dask Array for array workloads.
reading_evidence.performance: Authors report 2.66x average speedup over the fastest comparable baseline and 96.7% API coverage on their selected 30-case test suite; these are workload/test-suite-specific, not universal guarantees.
reading_evidence.ablation: PDF page 11, VI-D: dynamic tiling Q2 and Q7 improvements of 7.08x and 10.59x compared with disabling the feature.
reading_evidence.deployment: PDF pages 1-2: authors report production adoption with clusters up to 5000 CPU cores, distinct from their own 16-worker evaluation cluster.

papers.title: MLKV: Efficiently Scaling up Large Embedding Model Training with Disk-based Key-Value Storage
papers.copy_note: Version-pinned author preprint; may differ from the final proceedings version.

reading_evidence.contribution: Reusable disk-backed key-value embedding storage based on FASTER with per-embedding bounded staleness and look-ahead prefetching.
reading_evidence.evaluation: Section IV: seven datasets, including five public datasets and two eBay production datasets; three training task families, end-to-end convergence, throughput and storage overhead.
reading_evidence.scale: eBay-Trisk 185 million graph nodes; eBay-Payout 1.7 billion graph nodes; the latter case study labels a 2.38 TB embedding model. These numbers are not ICDE minimum requirements.
reading_evidence.performance: IV-B: larger-than-memory GNN node classification variants show 1.53-12.57x throughput improvements relative to the compared offloading configurations.
reading_evidence.ablation: IV-C and IV-D isolate bounded staleness and look-ahead prefetching; IV-E uses YCSB to quantify storage overhead.

additional_abstract_only.title: CDMap: Complementarity and Disparity-aware Map Inference Quality Enhancement
additional_abstract_only.note: Only the institutional abstract and venue metadata were inspected. No PDF was downloaded; do not treat this as full-text experimental evidence. It addresses sparse and mixed trajectory data for map inference, with Didi-collected trajectory data.
